# The footballer, phase 3: the splat fit. The gated form (p2) unchanged; only slimmed for the
# splats (x 0.96, depth 0.84) so the baked figure keeps the sheet's proportions. Generated by
# make_player.py; run with --no-save --to player_fit.rmdl.
select Player
active Player
scale 0.96 0.84 1.00
apply --scale
export player_fit.glb
